inputs.text: 15:03: a Long March carrier rocket carrying a satellite, launched from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center, entered Taiwan's air defence identification zone, passed from Tainan over Taitung outside the atmosphere, on a path that differed from the satellite launch path notified by the US FAA; possible risk from debris.

fields.description: At 15:03 a Long March rocket carrying a satellite, launched from Xichang Satellite Launch Center, passed from Tainan over Taitung outside the atmosphere, off its notified launch path. Falling debris is possible.
fields.headline: Satellite launch rocket passed over Taiwan; possible debris risk
fields.instruction: Stay alert and follow official updates. Do not touch or approach any suspected debris; report it to the authorities.
fields.note_for_reviewer: The input gives no end time and no confirmed debris, so I set certainty to Possible and severity to Moderate. The rocket's path was Tainan to Taitung, but the operator chose a nationwide area; please confirm both choices before release.
